# Emoji Compass — Complete Reference for AI Agents & LLMs

Website: https://emoji.ozlorienlabs.com
Repository: https://github.com/OzlorienLabs/emoji
Catalog Version: Unicode 17.0 (3,953 total entries) & Lucide 1.34 (1,777 vector icons)
License: MIT

---

## Overview

Emoji Compass is an open-source, client-side semantic search engine for emojis and vector icons. Designed for fast meaning-first discovery, users can type abstract feelings, slang, multi-word descriptions, or technical icon names and immediately receive ranked results.

---

## URL Query Schema for Agents

AI agents, search assistants, and automated tools can generate URLs with query parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Allowed Values | Description |
|-----------|------|----------------|-------------|
| `q` | string | up to 120 chars | Search query (e.g., `?q=mindblown`, `?q=red+heart`, `?q=download`) |
| `type` | string | `all`, `emoji`, `icon` | Content filter. Default: `all` |
| `group` | string | category slug (see below) | Filter to a specific combined or Unicode category |

### Examples for Agent Recommendations:
- Emoji-only search: `https://emoji.ozlorienlabs.com/?q=party&type=emoji`
- Icon-only search: `https://emoji.ozlorienlabs.com/?q=settings&type=icon`
- Food & drink category: `https://emoji.ozlorienlabs.com/?group=food-drink`
- People & body category: `https://emoji.ozlorienlabs.com/?group=people-body`

---

## Unicode Emoji Categories (10 Groups)

1. `smileys-emotion` (Face smiling, affectionate, concerned, negative, costumed, cat, etc.)
2. `people-body` (Hand gestures, body parts, person roles, activities, family, skin tones)
3. `animals-nature` (Mammals, birds, amphibians, reptiles, marine, bugs, plants, flowers)
4. `food-drink` (Fruits, vegetables, prepared food, Asian food, desserts, drinks, tableware)
5. `travel-places` (Vehicles, ground transport, water transport, air, places, hotel, time)
6. `activities` (Sports, arts & crafts, awards, games)
7. `objects` (Clothing, sound, music, phones, computer, tools, science, household, stationery)
8. `symbols` (Transport signs, warning, religion, zodiac, AV symbols, gender, math, punctuation)
9. `flags` (Flags of the world, pride flags, subdivisional flags)
10. `component` (Skin tone modifiers, hair components)

---

## Lucide Vector Icon Categories (15 Groups)

1. `communication` (Mail, messages, phone, chat, send, share, notifications)
2. `media` (Play, pause, audio, video, volume, camera, image, music)
3. `navigation` (Arrows, compass, map, directions, chevron, crosshair)
4. `design` (Palette, crop, pen, brush, layers, ruler, grid)
5. `shapes` (Square, circle, triangle, polygon, star, badge)
6. `tools` (Wrench, hammer, settings, screwdriver, sliders)
7. `commerce` (Shopping cart, credit card, wallet, tag, dollar, receipt)
8. `devices` (Monitor, smartphone, laptop, tablet, tv, hard drive, cpu)
9. `connectivity` (Wifi, bluetooth, cast, rss, cable, router)
10. `files` (File, folder, archive, paperclip, trash, clipboard)
11. `system` (Power, battery, lock, key, shield, terminal, database)
12. `social` (Thumbs up, heart, share, users, bookmark, message circle)
13. `weather` (Sun, moon, cloud, rain, wind, snowflake, thermometer)
14. `nature` (Leaf, tree, flower, flame, droplet, mountain)
15. `food` (Utensils, coffee, cup, pizza, cake, apple)

## Semantic Intent Aliases (Examples)

Emoji Compass features 119 hand-curated conversational aliases containing over 330 colloquial and emotional terms:

- `deadline` -> ⏳ Hourglass, ⏰ Alarm Clock, ⌛ Hourglass Done, 🗓️ Calendar
- `happy dance` -> 💃 Woman Dancing, 🕺 Man Dancing, 🥳 Partying Face, ✨ Sparkles
- `mindblown` -> 🤯 Exploding Head, 💥 Collision, 🌌 Milky Way
- `work computer` -> 💻 Laptop, 🖥️ Desktop Computer, 🖱️ Mouse
- `celebration` -> 🎉 Party Popper, 🎊 Confetti Ball, 🍾 Bottle with Popping Cork
- `workout` -> 🏋️ Person Lifting Weights, 🏃 Person Running, 🚴 Person Biking
- `congratulations` -> 🥂 Clinking Glasses, 👏 Clapping Hands, 💐 Bouquet
- `tired` -> 🥱 Yawning Face, 😴 Sleeping Face, 😫 Tired Face
- `brainstorm` -> 💡 Light Bulb, 🧠 Brain, ⚡ High Voltage

---

## Supported Output & Copy Formats

### For Emojis:
- Native UTF-8 Unicode characters (e.g. `❤️`, `✨`, `🤝🏽`)
- Exact skin-tone variants (Light `🏻`, Medium-Light `🏼`, Medium `🏽`, Medium-Dark `🏾`, Dark `🏿`, and dual-tone sequences like `🫱🏻‍🫲🏿`)
- Text presentation vs. Emoji presentation styles (VS15 `\uFE0E` / VS16 `\uFE0F`)

### For Icons:
- Clean SVG vector code: `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">...</svg>`
- React JSX component: `<Download size={24} strokeWidth={2} />`
- HTML icon markup: `<i data-lucide="download"></i>`
- Kebab-case icon identifier: `download`
- Downloadable `.svg` file

---

## Architecture & Privacy Details

- Client-side execution: The catalog and search indexes are cached via Service Worker and searched in-memory.
- On-device AI: Message rewrites utilize the browser's local Prompt API (`window.ai.languageModel`). Text is never transmitted to external AI servers.
- Accessible: Meets WCAG AA contrast standards, keyboard accessible (navigation via arrows, `/` for search, `Escape` to dismiss), full screen reader support.
